project.name: BSL 2026 Launch & Campaign Platform
project.description: Launch education and expectation campaign for BSL Colombia Nov 4–6; reusable marketing admin, scheduling, activity and planned $LKS bonus tracking.

root.name: BSL Colombia 2026: educate, connect and track activity
root.description: Campaign begins Monday October 26, 2026 in America/Bogota. Deliver campaign assets and a reusable, auditable marketing platform. $LKS tier and distribution rules are not final. See the linked GitHub issue and repository campaign pack.

tasks.name: Campaign operations
tasks.description: Campaign operations workstream. Complete the child tasks and link verification evidence.
acceptance: Complete child tasks and link verification evidence.
Record blockers, responsible owner and next follow-up date.

tasks.name: Resolve eligible existing-user audience and suppression rules
tasks.description: Use registered active users with newsletter consent; report counts only. Verify unsubscribe, duplicate addresses and inactive accounts.
acceptance: Report eligible and excluded counts without disclosing addresses.
Verify current opt-in, normalized deduplication and last-moment suppression.

tasks.name: Document $LKS tier activity and testnet bonus boundaries
tasks.description: Record the owner brief. Tier thresholds, final cutoff, allocation, claim contract and TGE date remain unannounced. Distinguish testnet preparation from on-chain publication.
acceptance: Record the user-exclusive TGE bonus and forthcoming tiers.
Keep allocation, cutoff, TGE date and claim contract unannounced until the owner supplies them.

tasks.name: Review Bogotá campaign calendar and per-message prerequisites
tasks.description: Six planned sends: Oct 26/28/30, Nov 2/3 at 09:00 and Nov 4 at 07:00. No dates inferred from UTC server time.
acceptance: Review all six explicit America/Bogota timestamps.
Confirm dispatcher capacity against the real audience and mailbox limit.

tasks.name: Emails, guides and social assets
tasks.description: Emails, guides and social assets workstream. Complete the child tasks and link verification evidence.
acceptance: Complete child tasks and link verification evidence.
Record blockers, responsible owner and next follow-up date.

tasks.name: Prepare six Spanish and English emails, HTML and text
tasks.description: Each has subject, preheader, one CTA, tracked campaign URL and unsubscribe footer. No invented TGE amounts or deadlines.
acceptance: Review 12 HTML and text previews plus image descriptions.
Confirm every product CTA, guide URL and injected unsubscribe link in a real test message.

tasks.name: Render BSL anticipation video and social poster
tasks.description: Caption-led 1080x1920 source, MP4 and poster; official brand assets; event date/location from catalogue.
acceptance: Export an 18-second 1080x1920 MP4 and 1080x1350 poster.
Check logo, contrast, captions and official Nov 4–6 dates.

tasks.name: Publish agenda, meeting and Contacts tutorial videos
tasks.description: Show an accurate three-step flow, readable captions and clear acceptance/access constraints. Provide text guides and alt text.
acceptance: Provide agenda, meeting, Contacts and activity videos with text alternatives.
Distinguish pending requests from confirmed meetings, favorites from seat guarantees and XP from token bonuses.

tasks.name: Verify public asset and guide URLs
tasks.description: Deploy assets, verify media MIME/status and mobile rendering before calendar activation. Contacts must be deployed before its tutorial send.
acceptance: Verify all five MP4s, posters and guide page return successful public responses.
Review organizer updates and actual logged-in product flows before marking assets ready.

tasks.name: Reusable marketing admin and delivery scheduler
tasks.description: Reusable marketing admin and delivery scheduler workstream. Complete the child tasks and link verification evidence.
acceptance: Complete child tasks and link verification evidence.
Record blockers, responsible owner and next follow-up date.

tasks.name: Add campaign, outbox, suppression and audit schema
tasks.description: Service-role-only tables; immutable scheduled copy; unique campaign-recipient pair; leased delivery claims and explicit unknown outcomes.
acceptance: Apply dependency-ordered migrations on development and test queue idempotence.
Verify global admin boundaries, RLS grants and private recipient fields.

tasks.name: Upgrade dashboard Emails with calendar and sent ledger
tasks.description: Create/save, preview, schedule, pause and cancel; show Bogotá schedule, provider acceptance vs confirmed delivery, queued/failed/unknown/suppressed totals.
acceptance: Verify desktop/mobile and light/dark calendar, editor, history and snapshot states.
Check bilingual editing, dirty-state activation, readiness and pause/resume/cancel behavior.

tasks.name: Connect bounded scheduled sender to existing provider
tasks.description: Shared global-admin boundary, constant-time runner token checks, concurrency-safe claims, no automatic resend after ambiguous SMTP acceptance.
acceptance: Test before-send opt-out and immutable copy after queueing.
Never automatically replay unknown SMTP outcomes; verify stable provider message IDs.

tasks.name: Implement unsubscribe and current-consent rechecks
tasks.description: Opaque signed/unguessable token, one-click POST, confirmation GET, global suppression; no recipient list in public API.
acceptance: GET only confirms; POST supports one-click unsubscribe.
Remove current newsletter consent and suppress pending campaigns.

tasks.name: Run SQL, API, scheduler and responsive UI tests
tasks.description: Exercise authorization, scheduling/timezone, pause/cancel, retries, stale leases, partial delivery, opt-out races and account/event isolation.
acceptance: Pass relevant component/API/SMTP/SQL tests and changed-file typechecking.
Pass design/type guards, Storybook build and four-mode browser QA.

tasks.name: Tier activity ledger and testnet snapshot preparation
tasks.description: Tier activity ledger and testnet snapshot preparation workstream. Complete the child tasks and link verification evidence.
acceptance: Complete child tasks and link verification evidence.
Record blockers, responsible owner and next follow-up date.

tasks.name: Define all-interaction event taxonomy and trust levels
tasks.description: Document observed navigation separately from verified server actions. Never log passwords, tokens, messages or wallet keys.
acceptance: Document verified action types, unique source keys and deployment start boundary.
Separate observed navigation from verified awards; define remaining interaction types before claiming universal coverage.

tasks.name: Record unique verified interaction bonus receipts
tasks.description: Agenda favorites/confirmations, meeting lifecycle, contact requests/connections and interest selection have stable source IDs and dedupe keys.
acceptance: Verify agenda, meeting, interest and mutual-contact triggers.
Repeated requests and toggles cannot inflate the same source action.

tasks.name: Add immutable testnet snapshot preparation and export
tasks.description: Explicit cutoff and network label, deterministic digest, per-user verified points; unpublished status and no chain/contract/transaction invented.
acceptance: Prepare deterministic private manifests and SHA-256 digests at explicit past cutoffs.
Show testnet/unpublished until a real network, contract and signer are configured and publication succeeds.

tasks.name: Announce tiers and final allocation rules when defined
tasks.description: Publish eligibility/cutoff/allocation/claim details from an authoritative owner. Do not equate Network XP with $LKS tokens.
acceptance: Obtain final tier thresholds, allocation, eligibility cutoff and claim steps from rewards owner.
Publish authoritative terms before activating the activity email.

tasks.name: Launch execution and follow-up
tasks.description: Launch execution and follow-up workstream. Complete the child tasks and link verification evidence.
acceptance: Complete child tasks and link verification evidence.
Record blockers, responsible owner and next follow-up date.

tasks.name: Load drafts, test a real internal seed audience and activate schedule
tasks.description: Verify production credentials, migration, SMTP mailbox limits and public links. Owner-authorized recipients only; keep logs free of addresses.
acceptance: Complete production backup/migration, deployment, configured sender and internal test.
Activate dispatcher and schedule verified campaigns by Oct 25; keep incomplete campaigns in draft.

tasks.name: Monitor each scheduled touch and failed/unknown outcomes
tasks.description: Track accepted sends separately from confirmed delivery; stop/reconcile unknown outcomes, no blind replay.
acceptance: Inspect every send for acceptance, rejection, uncertainty and suppression.
Reconcile provider logs before any replay; do not invent inbox, open or click metrics.

tasks.name: Publish Nov 4 attendee checklist and organizer updates
tasks.description: Check venue/programme notices; no fake confirmed meetings, access rights or seat guarantees.
acceptance: Check current venue, pass access, saved agenda and accepted meeting states.
Publish the Nov 4 checklist at the planned Bogotá time.

tasks.name: Report engagement and close campaign follow-ups
tasks.description: Compare eligible audience, provider-accepted sends, unsubscribes, verified product actions and successful mutual connections. No fabricated open rates.
acceptance: Report eligible audience, accepted sends, unsubscribes and verified engagement.
Record unresolved follow-ups and link evidence by Nov 6.
